description_for_human: The evidence layer for self-hosted AI inference. Ask one host what is loaded, what will run right now, and what is wrong — with the evidence behind every answer.
description_for_model: Wicklee monitors local AI inference fleets and answers questions about the models on a host. Hardware and efficiency: GPU health, WES (Wicklee Efficiency Score = tok/s / watts / thermal_penalty), inference state (live/idle-spd/busy/idle), thermal status, power draw, TTFT, queue depth across Ollama and vLLM. Models and readiness, on a localhost agent: GET /v1/state for what is installed and loaded with the context each model is running at; GET /v1/readiness before starting a task, to see whether a model can run without displacing another (a requires_loading answer carrying coexistence: "unverified" fits by memory accounting only and must not be treated as safe — measurement showed the runtime still evicting a resident model in 5 of 6 such cases); GET /v1/inspect for findings about slow or unstable inference. Every statement carries a label — observed, inferred or verified — and the evidence behind it, and anything that could not be checked is listed rather than omitted, so an empty result never means a clean bill of health. POST /v1/receipts to hand back your runtime's own final-response metadata; it stores metadata only and refuses a payload carrying prompt, response, messages or context. The agent is localhost-only and needs no authentication when bound to loopback. There is no hosted API.
